prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 25 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1240; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on collision with right shoulder pain and restricted range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the findings and is plausible for a collision of this type. Over the course of 25 visits, care followed a conventional rehabilitation pathway, including manual therapy, graded therapeutic exercise, and home exercise instruction. Visit frequency was reduced progressively as strength and range of motion improved and pain decreased. Examination revealed positive findings on several provocative shoulder tests consistent with soft tissue involvement, while other neurovascular and stability assessments were within normal limits. The patient reports no prior injury or treatment involving this shoulder. Billed services correspond to the documented visits, with no duplicate or repeated charges identified. At last review the patient was improving and was discharged to independent home program management with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
